summary: Apps can download a file to disk with progress and cancel through the URLSession counterpart. There is no asset-pack API, no manifest, no download scheduling while the app is not running, and no app-store-hosted assets.

features.note: no pack concept, no on-demand pack status or removal

features.feature: System-scheduled downloads while the app is not running (ManagedDownloaderExtension, BAAppGroupID, BAHasManagedAssetPacks)
features.bifrost: none for apps; the OS updater downloads only system updates in springboard/src/shell/update.rs
features.note: the updater is not exposed to apps

features.feature: Apple-hosted packs and App Store Connect upload
features.apple: BAUsesAppleHosting, Creating managed asset packs, Downloading Apple-hosted asset packs
features.note: tied to App Store Connect; the PC App Store has no hosted asset service

features.apple: Reducing download and storage demands with localized asset packs
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/locale.rs gives the language, but nothing selects packs by it

features.feature: Testing packs against a local mock server
Unmanaged download manager and URL downloads (BADownloadManager, BAURLDownload, BADownload)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/url.rs (download_task: dest.part renamed on success, progress, cancel)
features.note: runs only while the app is alive; no persistent queue, no scheduling, no essential/non-essential priority
no extension that runs while the app is closed or before first launch

features.feature: System update download with size and hash check
features.apple: not part of the framework; closest system-side analogue
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/update.rs (download(), springboard.part, verify then rename), springboard/updated/src

gaps: No app-facing asset-pack API (list, download on demand, status, remove, manifest)
No download scheduling that continues or starts while the app is closed, including before first launch
No persistent download queue with essential and non-essential priorities
No local mock server for testing packs
